press.what_text: CreatorBoostAI is an execution operating system that sits on top of existing CRM, AMS, MLS, marketing, and communications stacks. BodyIQ-AI is the human-signal intelligence layer powering high-stakes interaction strategy.
press.what_does_text: It analyzes signals across visual, auditory, and behavioral channels — then executes the recommended next action across the customer's existing software. Lead qualification, follow-up, pipeline movement, commission, audit — all unified.
press.defensible_text: Proprietary signal-definition library + patent-pending execution engine + private cohort training data. Distribution through existing software (no rip-and-replace) creates rapid embed; the more it executes, the more intelligence it accrues.
